caption: The drawing features a single object suspended from the top of the composition, centered on a plain, light beige background. The object appears to be a dark, metallic or iron tool or implement, rendered in shades of dark gray. It consists of a thin vertical element extending downward from a loop or ring, which is attached to a longer, more flexible component that curves upward. This upper component is depicted with a slight shadow, suggesting a sense of depth. The lower portion is a solid, slightly irregular form with a concave, trough-like shape, casting a soft shadow below it. The entire drawing utilizes grayscale shading to define form and suggests light falling from the left side, with shadows cast to the right and below the object.
title: Hanging Lamp
